trial_court: Court of Jitendra Kumar Mishra, Additional District Judge -III, Rohini Courts, Delhi. Civil Suit no. 426/11
case_name: Smt. Man Bhavti vs Smt. Durgawati

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Man Bhavti, Sh. Ram Ujagir, Sh. Ram Millan (plaintiffs)
parties.respondent_defendant: Smt. Durgawati, Sh. Sanjay, Ms. Archana, Ms. Vandana (defendants)

facts_of_case: Plaintiffs are legal heirs of late Sh. Ram Nath who died intestate and left behind suit property. Defendant no. 1 started to live as a concubine of late Sh. Ram Nath. Plaintiffs filed a suit for possession and permanent injunction.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the plaintiff to prove her case.
legal_principles.held: It is admitted case of the plaintiff that she did not have any proof of marriage because she got married with late Sh. Ram Nath in her childhood.

legal_principles.principle: The court will consider the facts and circumstances of each case to determine the legal rights of the parties.
legal_principles.held: Prior to that she was at Nehru Nagar. It is further admitted case of the plaintiff that when she started to live with her husband then defendant no. 1 also resided with her husband at that time.

outcome.final_order: Plaintiffs are in occupation and in possession of one room on the second floor and are using latrine and bath room commonly.

use_for_drafting: advising on property rights in joint family
representing clients in disputes over shared assets
